{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'channel' column
print("Channel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the unique values in the 'converted' column
print("\nConverted distribution:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of revenue
print("\nRevenue distribution:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())

# Check if there are any records with zero revenue but converted
print("\nRecords with zero revenue but converted:")
print(sales_df[(sales_df['revenue'] == 0) & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)].shape[0])

# Check the relationship between channel and converted
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_by_channel)"}
